Normal shared-stop range. Pairs up to this distance can join records into a group. Set at 150 ft so plausible displaced stops around 100 ft are scored normally instead of sitting at the edge of the range.
Start of the evidence-assisted rescue range. Pairs between this distance and rescue_max_ft are scored and reported for review only; they never join records into a group.
End of the evidence-assisted rescue range.
Minimum pair/group evidence score for high-confidence shared-stop candidates inside the primary range.
Minimum pair score for a likely shared-stop candidate inside the primary range.
Minimum pair score for an uncertain shared-stop candidate inside the primary range.
Minimum score for a <=150 ft cross-operator pair to connect source records into a candidate group.
Every observed primary-range cross-operator member pair must meet this score for a high-confidence group.
Exact-coordinate groups at or above this size receive a caution against automatic high-confidence treatment.
